summary: At the board meeting Ryan mocks Emma as the maid and Lily calls her pathetic. Emma takes the chairman's seat and announces she is the new owner of Blake Group, then fires Ryan. In the corridor Harlow reveals her real name is Emma Sterling, Richard Sterling's daughter, and Ryan asks who he really married.

key_events.description: Ryan calls Emma the maid and calls security
Emma sits in the chairman's seat
Emma announces she is the new owner of Blake Group
Lily drops her glass in shock
Harlow reveals Emma is Richard Sterling's daughter
Ryan asks who the woman he married really is

ending_cliffhanger.description: Ryan: Then who is the woman I married?
